goal: Decide what the nightly docs sync does to uor.foundation. The site must never swap its docs for an empty or unchecked release.

app.name: site-docs-sync
app.title: Docs sync
app.purpose: Decide whether one run of the Prism docs sync keeps the current docs, refuses to overwrite them, finds nothing changed, or commits and redeploys the site, from the docs-site branch, the seed flag, the pages found, the prism-code package check and whether the generated files changed.

fields.name: branch
fields.means: whether the docs-site branch of UOR-Foundation/PrismPM exists

fields.name: seed
fields.means: whether the run passes --seed, the one-time import from main's docs/generated

fields.name: pages
fields.means: Markdown pages found under get-started, guides, api, reference, sdks, concepts, examples or migration

fields.name: package
fields.means: the prism-code npm latest check: verified, no latest release, tarball not matching its registry integrity, or no skill/SKILL.md in it

fields.name: changed
fields.means: whether the generated prism, npm and requests files differ from main

meanings.refuse: the sync throws and the current docs are not overwritten
meanings.redeploy: commit the generated files and run deploy.yml on main

rules.why: scripts/sync-prism-docs.mjs: docs-site branch not found; keeping current docs
scripts/sync-prism-docs.mjs: No pages found; refusing to overwrite the current docs
scripts/sync-prism-docs.mjs: npm registry gave no prism-code latest release; refusing to overwrite the current docs
scripts/sync-prism-docs.mjs: the prism-code tarball does not match its registry integrity
scripts/sync-prism-docs.mjs: the site publishes the package's skill/SKILL.md byte for byte, and refuses a release without one
.github/workflows/sync-prism-docs.yml: git diff --quiet on the generated files, then No changes

app.otherwiseWhy: .github/workflows/sync-prism-docs.yml: commit the generated files, push, and gh workflow run deploy.yml --ref main

properties.why: an empty docs tree never replaces the published docs
a tarball that fails its integrity never sets the versions or skill the site states
the site is redeployed only when the docs changed
without the branch, and without --seed, the docs are kept

stakeholders.name: Site visitor
stakeholders.text: Reads the Prism SDK docs and their Markdown twins on uor.foundation and needs them to be the current docs-site release, never an empty or unverified one.

stakeholders.name: Site maintainer
stakeholders.text: Owns the scheduled sync and needs it to redeploy only on a real change and to fail loudly instead of overwriting.

components.name: PrismPM docs-site branch
components.text: The branch of UOR-Foundation/PrismPM the docs are pulled from.

components.name: npm registry
components.text: Serves prism-code latest, its tarball and its integrity.

components.name: uor.foundation
components.text: The React, Vite and Tailwind site deploy.yml publishes to GitHub Pages.

threats.name: Docs wiped by an empty tree
threats.text: A reorganized or empty docs-site branch overwrites every docs page with nothing.

threats.name: Tampered prism-code tarball
threats.text: A tarball that differs from its registry integrity sets the published versions and agent skill.

threats.name: Compromised docs-site branch
threats.text: Someone with push access to the PrismPM docs-site branch publishes misleading docs.
threats.accepted: The site trusts the PrismPM repository as the docs authority; the generated files are committed, so every change is reviewable in history.

quality.text: Each of the four refusals the sync script throws is a rule answering refuse.
quality.measureText: Refusal checks of the sync script the app models.

quality.text: A run that changes no generated file does not redeploy.
quality.measureText: Acceptance vectors with no change answered redeploy.
